analysis.title: Market Rhythm Focus
key_insights: Overnight Nasdaq 100 futures briefly broke below the 200dma, then reversed and reclaimed it. EFG sees oversold conditions, mid-term clarity and a developing hammer candle, and calls the setup more constructive, provided the candle holds.

S&P 500 futures bounced off the September low and the June uptrend, both key supports. EFG says the market is oversold enough for a trading low but not extreme enough to guarantee follow-through, and is waiting for price confirmation.

TOPIX broke below the 200dma, then reversed back above it and left a clean hammer candle that EFG reads as a tradable low. It needs follow-up strength to confirm the bullish turn and avoid a failed bounce.
Hang Seng pushed against its downtrend after a very strong session. Key oscillators broke a three-month downtrend, and EFG says a hold would start to look like a tradable reversal.
Euro Stoxx 50 broke a clean downtrend as RSI pushed above 50. The 200dma has repelled several sell attempts. A move above 6,223/51 would confirm a neckline break and clear 50dma resistance.
risk_factors: The Nasdaq 100 hammer candle must hold for the constructive setup to stand.
The S&P 500 bounce may not follow through, since oversold conditions are not extreme.
The TOPIX bounce could fail without follow-up strength.
vol_and_positioning: S&P 500 futures are described as oversold enough for a trading low but not extreme enough to guarantee follow-through.
Nasdaq 100 futures are described as showing oversold conditions.
